A.answers: base option argmax; majority; ties use largest mean option probability; exact remaining tie first option
A.primary_accuracy: reference split 0 test; all 30 test splits also reported; whole 500-video cohort descriptive
A.promotion: existing promote robust_safe; prefix mean AURC patched in memory only
A.support: mean probability assigned to own fixed answer, across 3 bases or all 12 nodes

B.predictions: Existing P5 full-VHD holdout LR/HGB reused
B.resamples: Reuse P5 exact saved source-video draws
B.vote: base_vote_fraction; also report archived confidence tie-break as sensitivity
B.percentile: 100*midrank/N within each model and subset; high percentile means trusted; joint wrong defined from same base bank

C: read-only source inspection; no experimental scripts run
D: primary literature and model documents only; comparisons descriptive
